entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-26
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Unsafe expression not supported for property #86211
  • Stack overflow for nested type constraints with updated-memory-safety-rules enabled #86208

Closed

  • CSharpRemoveUnusedVariableCodeFixProvider crashes if unused variable value is set in an if statement with no braces #78528
  • Don't report CA1704 for numeric type parameter names (T1, T2, …) #85924
